sourceContracts.title: Graph model configuration modal
permissionRules: Authenticated owner browser session; /api owner hook returns 401 if absent and 503 during maintenance. Mutations require configured Origin and CSRF token (apps/server/app.ts:141). No administrator/member role split is implemented for these owner surfaces.
Graph rejects share principals. Graph control/state/command management requires principal.id=web-owner; evidence/explore scope follows sourceAccess authorization (analysis-source.ts:31).

fields.name: 服务地址
fields.constraints: <=2048 characters; http/https only, no credentials/query/hash. HTTP allowed loopback, or Ollama private IPv4 LAN. Conditional provider fields hidden when none.

fields.name: 模型名称
fields.constraints: <=200 characters; model calls require nonblank model and baseURL.

fields.name: API 密钥
fields.constraints: <=8192 chars; no CR/LF. Blank normally retains; clear checkbox sends removal; provider/address change clears stored credential.

fields.name: 清除已保存密钥
fields.constraints: No additional client constraint found; server validation not otherwise verified.

fields.name: 允许发送至非本机模型
fields.constraints: remoteContentAllowed required boolean; explicit permission needed to send actual note content off-loopback.

fields.name: 自动分析内容变化
fields.constraints: No additional client constraint found; server validation not otherwise verified.
